messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey there!

i'm tal - your talent agent who finds people jobs that actually pay. not advice, not gyaan, real interviews at companies in bangalore and beyond.

think of me as your inside person who knows which startups are dying, who's actually hiring, and what they're really paying.

so... what's your full name?
Yukti Grover

yukti grover... that's a name with some serious energy. 

where you working these days?
I am working at Flipkart right now as an application developer

flipkart... building the everything app that half of india shops on. found you on linkedin - engineer at flipkart, cse from kurukshetra university. 

this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/yukti-grover-113914271
Yep that's me

engineering at flipkart... building the tech that powers those 10 minute deliveries and flash sales that crash the app every time. kurukshetra university to one of india's biggest tech companies - that's solid work.

what made you pick application development? were you always into the backend systems side or did you fall into it?
It will be 1 and half year this month

I was into the backend system from the start but I didn't get the role i wanted... As you know application engineer and software engineer are different role with same work but very big difference in pay wise

ah the classic flipkart move... same code, same late nights debugging, but "application engineer" gets you 30% less because of a fancy title game. they really thought you wouldn't notice that one.

backend systems are where the real magic happens anyway - apis, databases, the stuff that actually makes flipkart work when everyone's panic-buying during sales.

how long you been working total?

1.5 years... so you're past the "fresh grad figuring things out" phase but still early enough to make some serious moves. perfect timing actually.

what kind of role you looking for next?

Software developer that actually pays well.
I am not scared of challenges it's opposite i love challenges
